title: PB Powder Greek Yogurt Bowl
description: High-protein, low-effort lunch bowl built on plain Greek yogurt and powdered peanut butter, with a choice of fresh fruit, jam, or maple syrup for sweetness
ingredients: 1/2 cup (62g) fresh raspberries (or berry of choice)
instructions: In a small bowl, whisk 2 tbsp (16g) powdered peanut butter with 1.5 tbsp (22ml) water until smooth and no lumps remain.
Spoon 1 cup (245g) plain 0% Greek yogurt into a serving bowl.
Swirl the peanut butter mixture through the yogurt.
Top with 1/2 cup (62g) fresh raspberries and serve immediately.
notes:
Sweetener options, swap for the fresh raspberries above:

1) FRESH FRUIT (lowest sugar, most volume): 1/2 cup (62g) raspberries [+12g carbs, +4g fibre] · 1/2 cup (74g) blueberries [+11g carbs, +2g fibre, slightly more sugar] · 1/2 cup (83g) sliced strawberries [+6g carbs, lowest calorie density].

2) JAM (go no-added-sugar): 1 tbsp (20g) no-added-sugar strawberry, raspberry, blackberry, or cherry jam adds roughly 20-30 cal and 5-7g carbs, almost entirely sugar, with no fibre. More concentrated flavor, less food volume than fresh fruit.

3) MAPLE SYRUP: 1-2 tsp (7-14g) maple syrup adds roughly 20-40 cal and 5-9g carbs, no fibre. Simplest option, no fruit prep needed.

All three options land in a similar calorie/carb range in small amounts — pick based on whether you want fibre and volume (fresh fruit), concentrated flavor (jam), or simplicity (maple).
